archiveIntent: Pre-purchase inspection and offer decisions for secondhand complete electric RC cars. The existing pre-run guide covers cars the reader already owns. The kit cost list covers buying and finishing new kits.

findings.verified: Tamiya documents four independent suspension corners and oil dampers. The assembly instructions show chassis, mounting hardware and suspension components. RC Driver supplies separate contemporary coverage of the same kit.
ARRMA lists the stock red/white brushed Ready-to-Run package with a Spektrum battery and USB charger. A used seller's inventory remains separate evidence.
The AXI03008V2 manual documents the separate micro servo and the DIG function on the SLT3 momentary channel-three controls. Used equipment must be identified independently.
Spektrum directs owners to inspect for damage and to discontinue use of damaged or swollen packs. No pack of unknown condition is required for a test.
RC Paddock gives inspection context on photo requests and condition checks. The order, pricing framework and model examples are original editorial decisions.
